breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt included a contradictory instruction to use a Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift and also keep it gamma-centered. These are mutually exclusive settings. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'gamma-centered' part. The agent failed to fix this and repeated the contradictory request, stating to 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and gamma-centering.'
